appDescription: Platform to reconnect Teochew people with the diaspora

footer.description: Built from a personal journey, this platform helps overseas Chinese reconnect across oceans with lost family and roots.

home.heroSlogan: Across oceans, reconnecting the bloodline of Chinese worldwide
home.mapSubtitle: Click a marker on the map to view reunion posts in each region
home.howSubtitle: Three simple steps to reunite families
home.step1Desc: Turn fragments — dialect surnames, old place names, qiaopi letters — into searchable Chinese information
home.step2Desc: Record ancestor details and family stories; the system estimates generations and narrows your ancestral region
home.step3Desc: Reach clan associations, overseas Chinese federations, and volunteers so every clue finds its way
home.ctaDesc: Every post carries a family's hope. Start your search, or become a volunteer to help more families reunite.
